description: Both devices start a fresh Testnet session.
pairing: Same logical action on both firmwares.

description: Both devices scan the same published seed as a numeric SeedQR.
pairing: Same logical action on both firmwares.
difference: Both scan screens show a blank white preview and the same bottom instruction, but smartcard has black vertical bars on both sides while stock is white across the full width.
capture_note: Blank camera lead-in before the QR appears; decoder success is recorded in the debug log and the following screen.

description: Both devices show the scanned seed fingerprint and finalization choices.
pairing: Same logical action on both firmwares.
difference: Both Finalize Seed screens show fingerprint b2269592, but smartcard moves the fingerprint and Done button upward and replaces stock's single BIP-39 Passphrase button with Type Passphrase, Scan Passphrase, and Load Passphrase buttons.

description: Both devices finalize the scanned seed into memory.
pairing: Same logical action on both firmwares.
difference: Both seed options screens show fingerprint b2269592 and Scan transaction selected, but smartcard shifts the menu upward and shows BIP-85 child seed with a down arrow where stock shows the red Discard seed option.

description: Smartcard offers backup methods; stock keeps the scanned seed in memory.
pairing: Stock stays on its seed options; no card equivalent.
difference: Stock remains on seed options with Scan transaction selected, while smartcard shows Backup Seed with View seed words selected above To SeedKeeper, Export as SeedQR, and Export as Plaintext QR.

description: Smartcard asks for the inserted SeedKeeper PIN.
pairing: Stock stays on its seed options; no card equivalent.
difference: Stock remains on seed options with Scan transaction selected, while smartcard shows Card PIN with an empty entry field, a lowercase keyboard, ABC and 123 controls, and a green confirmation checkmark.

description: Smartcard reports that the SeedKeeper is not initialized.
pairing: Stock stays on its seed options; no card equivalent.
difference: Stock remains on seed options with Scan transaction selected, while smartcard shows Card Uninitialised with a yellow warning icon, a request to set a device PIN to complete card setup, and an orange I understand button.

description: Smartcard asks for a new SeedKeeper PIN.
pairing: Stock stays on its seed options; no card equivalent.
difference: Stock remains on seed options with Scan transaction selected, while smartcard shows New Card PIN with an empty entry field, a lowercase keyboard, ABC and 123 controls, and a green confirmation checkmark.

description: Smartcard asks to confirm the new SeedKeeper PIN.
pairing: Stock stays on its seed options; no card equivalent.
difference: Stock remains on seed options with Scan transaction selected, while smartcard shows Confirm Card PIN with an empty entry field, a lowercase keyboard, ABC and 123 controls, and a green confirmation checkmark.

description: Smartcard confirms SeedKeeper initialization.
pairing: Stock stays on its seed options; no card equivalent.
difference: Stock remains on seed options with Scan transaction selected, while smartcard shows Card Setup with a green circled checkmark, a message that the PIN is set and the seed can be imported next, and an orange OK button.

description: Smartcard offers the seed fingerprint as its card label.
pairing: Stock stays on its seed options; no card equivalent.
difference: Stock remains on seed options with Scan transaction selected, while smartcard shows Seed Label with b2269592 in the entry field above a lowercase keyboard and a green confirmation checkmark.

description: Smartcard confirms that the seed was saved to the SeedKeeper.
pairing: Stock stays on its seed options; no card equivalent.
difference: Stock remains on seed options with Scan transaction selected, while smartcard shows Secret Saved with a green circled checkmark, a message that the secret was successfully saved to Seedkeeper, and an orange OK button.

description: Smartcard asks before removing the seed from device memory, leaving the card copy.

description: Smartcard has discarded the current seed from device memory.
